subheader: An icon, the guarantee in a line or two and up to four supporting points.
lead: The points state the limits: how long, on what and who decides. Conditions hidden on another page make a guarantee harder to trust.
note: The note explains how to claim: who to ask, how and how long it takes.

points.title: When it starts and ends
points.text: A stated start date makes the period clear.

points.title: What it covers
points.text: And what it does not cover.

points.title: How to claim it
points.text: Explain it in one sentence. If it needs more, the process is too complicated.
